exams.title: REA Practice Test 1
exams.editionNotes: GRE Mathematics Test, 5th edition / Green Edition; published 2012, copyright 2010. Unofficial publisher-written practice exam. The supplied scan contains occasional handwritten marks, which remain visible in the original question images.

scoring.notes: REA supplies this shared approximate conversion table for all six practice tests (printed page x; PDF page 12). It is a publisher estimate, not an ETS-equated score or a prediction of a current GRE result. Raw score is correct minus one quarter of incorrect, rounded to the nearest whole number; blanks have no penalty. No score is extrapolated below the published raw-score range.
